framing: A gas connection is a precondition for clean cooking; a refill is the cooking. The scheme was justified on the second and is reported on the first.
gapReason: Different quantities — cumulative connections against refills per beneficiary per year. No subtraction is meaningful.

framing: Certification records a tap installed, not water delivered — a distinction the Ministry's own functionality assessment made.
gapReason: Different denominators. 82% is of ALL rural households; 76% is of CERTIFIED households, a subset of connected ones. Neither bounds the other, so no national functional-coverage figure is derivable and '6 points' would be invented.

framing: A card confers eligibility. An admission is care received. The two are cited interchangeably and differ by an order of magnitude.
gapReason: An eligibility stock against a flow of cumulative events. Subtracting them would compare a population to a count of episodes.

framing: The only pair in the dataset where both sides share a unit, so the wedge is real — and the chain does not end here.
notes: 0.92 crore. Occupancy, the third stage, has no measurement — see the absence declared on pmay-g-completed.

framing: Not a usage pair. The second is the honest measure of the same activity the first overstates: roughly 54,004 km of the network increase is reclassified state roads.
gapReason: Different quantities — network length in kilometres against build rate in kilometres per day. The relation is correction, not conversion.

framing: Airports were counted on a broadened basis including heliports and waterdromes; roughly half the routes launched to serve them have since stopped.
gapReason: Facilities against routes — different objects entirely.

b.label: Ridership against projection — no published series

framing: Metro projects were approved on ridership forecasts and a 14% return threshold; whether they meet those forecasts is not published as a series.
gapReason: The counterpart does not exist. Evidence comes from one-off CAG audits and academic studies, so the track figure cannot be qualified by anything and must not be read as though it had been.

b.label: Hours of supply received — no national series

framing: Saubhagya connected 2.86 crore households in eighteen months. How many hours a day they receive power is not measured nationally.
gapReason: The counterpart does not exist. Survey evidence indicates around 53% of villages received under twelve hours a day, but there is no continuous series.

framing: Net additions include re-joiners and job-switchers, so the same worker can be counted repeatedly; India maintains no register that would separate them.
gapReason: The counterpart does not exist. No establishment-level longitudinal payroll register exists, so first-time entry cannot be extracted from the net figure.

framing: e-Shram exists because the 2020 exodus showed the state could not identify its informal workforce. Whether registration converts into delivered social security is not reported.
gapReason: The counterpart does not exist as a series. Registration is published; downstream disbursement keyed to those identifiers is not.

framing: Rural India was declared open-defecation free in October 2019; independent panel evidence from the four states that mattered most found 44% still defecating in the open.
gapReason: Different populations and different instruments — a national WDI series against a four-state panel survey. The counterpart is a dispute between sources, not a series.

framing: The two instruments disagree about the direction of employment change, not merely its level — over 2017-18 to 2021-22 they record growth of opposite sign.
gapReason: Two figures that disagree about the sign of a change have a disagreement, not a gap. Neither is the corrective; neither may be shown alone.

framing: Roughly twenty percentage points apart, with the divergence concentrated almost entirely among women and showing no convergence across reference periods.
gapReason: A disagreement between instruments, not a measurable wedge.

title: PMLA cases initiated versus persons convicted
framing: The canonical coverage-versus-outcome pair for this domain. Reporting cases initiated without convictions, or the completed-trial conviction rate without the count of cases still pending, produces a materially different picture in either direction. Neither series may be rendered alone.
gapReason: Cases initiated and persons convicted are different quantities on different denominators (P-52); the two do not subtract.

title: Shutdown orders issued versus shutdown orders published
framing: An absence-pair: the coverage side is a third-party reconstruction and the usage side does not exist because the orders were not published, despite a binding direction to publish. The pair exists so the missing half renders as a finding rather than as an empty chart.
gapReason: The usage side does not exist: the orders were not published despite a binding direction to publish, so there is nothing to place beside the reconstructed count.

title: RTI applications filed versus information actually received
framing: Application volume is the coverage measure routinely cited; the usage measure is the share of applicants who obtained the information sought. Assessment work has found well under half succeeding, with under a tenth of the unsuccessful filing appeals, but the underlying assessment has not been pulled as a primary document and neither series is yet authored. Declared here so the pair is visible as owed rather than silently absent.
gapReason: The counterpart is not authored yet, so nothing is placed beside the coverage figure and no difference is stated.
